title: Sample with the exponential mechanism
prompt: Sample an exponential-mechanism candidate proportional to exp(epsilon*u/(2*sensitivity)). Return sampled index and probabilities. Utilities must be finite/nonempty, epsilon>=0 and supplied sensitivity>0. The bound is an external assumption; accepting it does not prove privacy of utility construction.

resources.title: The Algorithmic Foundations of Differential Privacy
